author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 잡목림, 침엽수림, 혼효림에 사는 흔한 텃새이다. 혼자 또는 암수가 함께 지내다가 번식이 끝나면 다른 새들과 섞여 숲속을 돌며 먹이를 찾는다. 곤충과 거미, 여러 씨앗과 열매를 먹으며, 4~6월에 알을 7개 낳는다. 전국에 살고, 국외에서는 아무르 남부, 우수리, 만주, 일본에 분포한다.

points.ko: 머리 길이만 한 길고 곧은 부리
points.en: long straight bill, as long as the head
brown and chestnut spots on the belly sides

art.subject: Eurasian Nuthatch (Sitta europaea), adult in winter plumage: blue-grey upperparts from crown to uppertail coverts, bold black eye-stripe, smoky reddish white where the forehead meets the bill, white chin, cheeks, ear coverts, throat and breast (breast sometimes washed reddish-yellow), buff belly with brown and chestnut spots on the sides, long straight bill as long as the head
art.pose: perched on a branch in mixed woodland, searching for insects
art.scene: Korean mixed conifer and broadleaf woodland in winter; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter plumage, side view perched: blue-grey upperparts, black eye-stripe, white throat and breast, buff belly with brown and chestnut spots on the sides, long straight bill
adult summer plumage, side view: same pattern but worn and faded overall
